C0184.title: Man Sentenced for Taking Payments to Post Fake Negative Reviews Against Competitors
C0184.summary: In November 2025, a court in Fuqing, Fujian, heard a case involving the posting of fake negative reviews. He, surnamed He, colluded with an upstream party to organize buyers to post false negative reviews on a competitor's store, aiming to smear and damage the competitor's reputation.
